linear.title: Linear Cutting Calculator | Cut List Calculator
linear.heading: Linear Cutting Calculator
linear.promise: Enter your stock lengths and pieces, get an efficient cut layout instantly.
linear.howTo.step1: Enter the stock bar length (and kerf if needed) in the Settings section.
linear.howTo.step2: Add each piece type: its length and how many copies you need.
linear.howTo.step3: Press Calculate to see the cut layout and waste summary.
linear.howTo.step4: Check the diagram or cut list, then verify measurements before cutting.
